source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), this unit can roll 1 D6 as a **[psychic roll](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities)** when it is **selected to fight**, as long as it is not **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**. If it does:

- a 1 makes this unit **battle-shocked**
- for the rest of that phase, **Wound rolls** of 1 for its melee attacks may be re-rolled
- for the rest of that phase, its melee attacks have **[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)**
